purpose: Supporting illustrations for the three quiz interludes

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a polished editorial illustration for an interstitial inside an English personal-finance iPhone quiz called Weekly Finances. LANDSCAPE 4:3 composition. Style: natural, emotionally believable adult portrait blended tastefully with a few dimensional rounded finance-planning tiles. A restrained, premium iOS aesthetic. Seamless deep graphite background #111210, tactile dark charcoal cards, vivid warm orange #ff8a34 highlights, soft cream highlights, subtle sage accents. Warm orange edge lighting, realistic skin, genuine small expressions, clean spacious composition, uncluttered. No words, numbers, percentages, currency symbols, logos, brands, watermarks, phone frames, captions or UI text anywhere. Any tiny chart lines must be clearly abstract decorative strokes, not data. Keep face and key props in central 75% of the image so it crops well on mobile. This is one coherent image, not a collage, contact sheet, screenshot, advertisement or multi-panel layout. Scene: a woman around 30 with warm medium-brown skin, shoulder-length natural dark curls, wearing a simple muted cream knit, seated at an almost invisible dark desk. A thoughtful, mildly uncertain expression, hand lightly by her chin, looking at three floating dark rounded cards representing an upcoming bill/calendar, a wallet and scattered account balances without any text. Her expression communicates recognition, not panic or despair. A gentle orange halo behind her shoulder connects the objects. A small orange calendar square is the focus. Waist-up, three-quarter pose, premium candid photography with subtle 3D accents.
